abstract: Operating guide for DeepInfra: API keys with per-key monthly spend limits, scoped JWTs, the OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints, concurrency rate limits, the Batch API, private LLM deployments and GPU container rentals billed per GPU-hour, LiteLLM and Claude Code wiring, teardown and troubleshooting. Checked against docs.deepinfra.com and the live model list on 2026-10-11; service tiers and a few lifecycle details are marked unverified.
